evidence: The issue defines a published pack contract, third-party installation command, precision-gated defaults, and a public done-when, but no GH702 spec packet, PR, or implementation branch exists.
Search of open pull requests and remote branches found no work item that owns GH702.
Existing guard-pack schema and installer are repository-local and cannot yet publish, resolve, verify, or atomically install an external pack.
The product and security choices are substantial enough to require product and technical specs before implementation.
GH702 can be specified independently of GH700 and GH701, while its public no-clone done-when remains coordinated with GH699.
maintainer_questions: Which pack locator, publisher identity, integrity/provenance, executable-capability, lifecycle, host-scope, and precision-policy choices should the approved contract use?
